what: Ambient firmware: lofi chords, nature scenes and generative pads and bells, each with its own pixel picture. Play and the music follows: notes loop, fade and change in an eight layer looper. A chords screen picks chords of the key, builds progressions of any chords or plays whole chords live. Drum kits, a backing bass, thirteen reverb and delay spaces, a tape FILM knob and a sleep timer.
author: Theo Wecker
